paragraphs.text: O foolish Galatians, who did bewitch you, before whose eyes Jesus Christ was openly set forth crucified?
paragraphs.original: Ὦ ἀνόητοι Γαλάται, τίς ὑμᾶς ἐβάσκανεν, οἷς κατʼ ὀφθαλμοὺς Ἰησοῦς Χριστὸς προεγράφη ἐσταυρωμένος;
paragraphs.translit: Ō anoētoi Galatai, tis hymas ebaskanen, hois katʼ ophthalmous Iēsous Christos proegraphē estaurōmenos;

paragraphs.text: This only would I learn from you. Received ye the Spirit by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?
paragraphs.original: τοῦτο μόνον θέλω μαθεῖν ἀφʼ ὑμῶν, ἐξ ἔργων νόμου τὸ πνεῦμα ἐλάβετε ἢ ἐξ ἀκοῆς πίστεως;
paragraphs.translit: touto monon thelō mathein aphʼ hymōn, ex ergōn nomou to pneuma elabete ē ex akoēs pisteōs;

paragraphs.text: Are ye so foolish? having begun in the Spirit, are ye now perfected in the flesh?
paragraphs.original: οὕτως ἀνόητοί ἐστε; ἐναρξάμενοι πνεύματι νῦν σαρκὶ ἐπιτελεῖσθε;
paragraphs.translit: houtōs anoētoi este; enarxamenoi pneumati nyn sarki epiteleisthe;

paragraphs.text: Did ye suffer so many things in vain? if it be indeed in vain.
paragraphs.original: τοσαῦτα ἐπάθετε εἰκῇ; εἴ γε καὶ εἰκῇ.
paragraphs.translit: tosauta epathete eikē; ei ge kai eikē.

paragraphs.text: He therefore that supplieth to you the Spirit, and worketh miracles among you, [doeth he it] by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?
paragraphs.original: ὁ οὖν ἐπιχορηγῶν ὑμῖν τὸ πνεῦμα καὶ ἐνεργῶν δυνάμεις ἐν ὑμῖν ἐξ ἔργων νόμου ἢ ἐξ ἀκοῆς πίστεως;
paragraphs.translit: ho oun epichorēgōn hymin to pneuma kai energōn dynameis en hymin ex ergōn nomou ē ex akoēs pisteōs;

paragraphs.text: Even as Abraham believed God, and it was reckoned unto him for righteousness.
paragraphs.original: καθὼς Ἀβραὰμ ἐπίστευσεν τῷ θεῷ, καὶ ἐλογίσθη αὐτῷ εἰς δικαιοσύνην.
paragraphs.translit: kathōs Abraam episteusen tō theō, kai elogisthē autō eis dikaiosynēn.

paragraphs.text: Know therefore that they that are of faith, the same are sons of Abraham.
paragraphs.original: Γινώσκετε ἄρα ὅτι οἱ ἐκ πίστεως, οὗτοι υἱοί εἰσιν Ἀβραάμ.
paragraphs.translit: Ginōskete ara hoti hoi ek pisteōs, houtoi hyioi eisin Abraam.

paragraphs.text: And the scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the Gentiles by faith, preached the gospel beforehand unto Abraham, [saying,] In thee shall all the nations be blessed.
paragraphs.original: προϊδοῦσα δὲ ἡ γραφὴ ὅτι ἐκ πίστεως δικαιοῖ τὰ ἔθνη ὁ θεὸς προευηγγελίσατο τῷ Ἀβραὰμ ὅτι Ἐνευλογηθήσονται ἐν σοὶ πάντα τὰ ἔθνη.
paragraphs.translit: proidousa de hē graphē hoti ek pisteōs dikaioi ta ethnē ho theos proeuēngelisato tō Abraam hoti Eneulogēthēsontai en soi panta ta ethnē.

paragraphs.text: So then they that are of faith are blessed with the faithful Abraham.
paragraphs.original: ὥστε οἱ ἐκ πίστεως εὐλογοῦνται σὺν τῷ πιστῷ Ἀβραάμ.
paragraphs.translit: hōste hoi ek pisteōs eulogountai syn tō pistō Abraam.

paragraphs.text: For as many as are of the works of the law are under a curse: for it is written, Cursed is every one who continueth not in all things that are written in the book of the law, to do them.
paragraphs.original: Ὅσοι γὰρ ἐξ ἔργων νόμου εἰσὶν ὑπὸ κατάραν εἰσίν, γέγραπται γὰρ ὅτι Ἐπικατάρατος πᾶς ὃς οὐκ ἐμμένει πᾶσιν τοῖς γεγραμμένοις ἐν τῷ βιβλίῳ τοῦ νόμου τοῦ ποιῆσαι αὐτά.
paragraphs.translit: Hosoi gar ex ergōn nomou eisin hypo kataran eisin, gegraptai gar hoti Epikataratos pas hos ouk emmenei pasin tois gegrammenois en tō bibliō tou nomou tou poiēsai auta.

paragraphs.text: Now that no man is justified by the law before God, is evident: for, The righteous shall live by faith;
paragraphs.original: ὅτι δὲ ἐν νόμῳ οὐδεὶς δικαιοῦται παρὰ τῷ θεῷ δῆλον, ὅτι Ὁ δίκαιος ἐκ πίστεως ζήσεται,
paragraphs.translit: hoti de en nomō oudeis dikaioutai para tō theō dēlon, hoti Ho dikaios ek pisteōs zēsetai,

paragraphs.text: and the law is not of faith; but, He that doeth them shall live in them.
paragraphs.original: ὁ δὲ νόμος οὐκ ἔστιν ἐκ πίστεως, ἀλλʼ· Ὁ ποιήσας αὐτὰ ζήσεται ἐν αὐτοῖς.
paragraphs.translit: ho de nomos ouk estin ek pisteōs, allʼ· Ho poiēsas auta zēsetai en autois.

paragraphs.text: Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law, having become a curse for us; for it is written, Cursed is every one that hangeth on a tree:
paragraphs.original: Χριστὸς ἡμᾶς ἐξηγόρασεν ἐκ τῆς κατάρας τοῦ νόμου γενόμενος ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν κατάρα, ὅτι γέγραπται· Ἐπικατάρατος πᾶς ὁ κρεμάμενος ἐπὶ ξύλου,
paragraphs.translit: Christos hēmas exēgorasen ek tēs kataras tou nomou genomenos hyper hēmōn katara, hoti gegraptai· Epikataratos pas ho kremamenos epi xylou,

paragraphs.text: that upon the Gentiles might come the blessing of Abraham in Christ Jesus; that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.
paragraphs.original: ἵνα εἰς τὰ ἔθνη ἡ εὐλογία τοῦ Ἀβραὰμ γένηται ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ, ἵνα τὴν ἐπαγγελίαν τοῦ πνεύματος λάβωμεν διὰ τῆς πίστεως.
paragraphs.translit: hina eis ta ethnē hē eulogia tou Abraam genētai en Christō Iēsou, hina tēn epangelian tou pneumatos labōmen dia tēs pisteōs.

paragraphs.text: Brethren, I speak after the manner of men: Though it be but a man`s covenant, yet when it hath been confirmed, no one maketh it void, or addeth thereto.
paragraphs.original: Ἀδελφοί, κατὰ ἄνθρωπον λέγω· ὅμως ἀνθρώπου κεκυρωμένην διαθήκην οὐδεὶς ἀθετεῖ ἢ ἐπιδιατάσσεται.
paragraphs.translit: Adelphoi, kata anthrōpon legō· homōs anthrōpou kekyrōmenēn diathēkēn oudeis athetei ē epidiatassetai.

paragraphs.text: Now to Abraham were the promises spoken, and to his seed. He saith not, And to seeds, as of many; but as of one, And to thy seed, which is Christ.
paragraphs.original: τῷ δὲ Ἀβραὰμ ἐρρέθησαν αἱ ἐπαγγελίαι καὶ τῷ σπέρματι αὐτοῦ· οὐ λέγει· Καὶ τοῖς σπέρμασιν, ὡς ἐπὶ πολλῶν, ἀλλʼ ὡς ἐφʼ ἑνός· Καὶ τῷ σπέρματί σου, ὅς ἐστιν Χριστός.
paragraphs.translit: tō de Abraam errethēsan hai epangeliai kai tō spermati autou· ou legei· Kai tois spermasin, hōs epi pollōn, allʼ hōs ephʼ henos· Kai tō spermati sou, hos estin Christos.

paragraphs.text: Now this I say: A covenant confirmed beforehand by God, the law, which came four hundred and thirty years after, doth not disannul, so as to make the promise of none effect.
paragraphs.original: τοῦτο δὲ λέγω· διαθήκην προκεκυρωμένην ὑπὸ τοῦ θεοῦ ὁ μετὰ τετρακόσια καὶ τριάκοντα ἔτη γεγονὼς νόμος οὐκ ἀκυροῖ, εἰς τὸ καταργῆσαι τὴν ἐπαγγελίαν.
paragraphs.translit: touto de legō· diathēkēn prokekyrōmenēn hypo tou theou ho meta tetrakosia kai triakonta etē gegonōs nomos ouk akyroi, eis to katargēsai tēn epangelian.

paragraphs.text: For if the inheritance is of the law, it is no more of promise: but God hath granted it to Abraham by promise.
paragraphs.original: εἰ γὰρ ἐκ νόμου ἡ κληρονομία, οὐκέτι ἐξ ἐπαγγελίας· τῷ δὲ Ἀβραὰμ διʼ ἐπαγγελίας κεχάρισται ὁ θεός.
paragraphs.translit: ei gar ek nomou hē klēronomia, ouketi ex epangelias· tō de Abraam diʼ epangelias kecharistai ho theos.

paragraphs.text: What then is the law? It was added because of transgressions, till the seed should come to whom the promise hath been made; [and it was] ordained through angels by the hand of a mediator.
paragraphs.original: Τί οὖν ὁ νόμος; τῶν παραβάσεων χάριν προσετέθη, ἄχρις οὗ ἔλθῃ τὸ σπέρμα ᾧ ἐπήγγελται, διαταγεὶς διʼ ἀγγέλων ἐν χειρὶ μεσίτου·
paragraphs.translit: Ti oun ho nomos; tōn parabaseōn charin prosetethē, achris hou elthē to sperma hō epēngeltai, diatageis diʼ angelōn en cheiri mesitou·

paragraphs.text: Now a mediator is not [a mediator] of one; but God is one.
paragraphs.original: ὁ δὲ μεσίτης ἑνὸς οὐκ ἔστιν, ὁ δὲ θεὸς εἷς ἐστιν.
paragraphs.translit: ho de mesitēs henos ouk estin, ho de theos heis estin.

paragraphs.text: Is the law then against the promises of God? God forbid: for if there had been a law given which could make alive, verily righteousness would have been of the law.
paragraphs.original: Ὁ οὖν νόμος κατὰ τῶν ἐπαγγελιῶν τοῦ θεοῦ; μὴ γένοιτο· εἰ γὰρ ἐδόθη νόμος ὁ δυνάμενος ζῳοποιῆσαι, ὄντως ἐκ νόμου ἂν ἦν ἡ δικαιοσύνη.
paragraphs.translit: Ho oun nomos kata tōn epangeliōn tou theou; mē genoito· ei gar edothē nomos ho dynamenos zōopoiēsai, ontōs ek nomou an ēn hē dikaiosynē.

paragraphs.text: But the scriptures shut up all things under sin, that the promise by faith in Jesus Christ might be given to them that believe.
paragraphs.original: ἀλλὰ συνέκλεισεν ἡ γραφὴ τὰ πάντα ὑπὸ ἁμαρτίαν ἵνα ἡ ἐπαγγελία ἐκ πίστεως Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ δοθῇ τοῖς πιστεύουσιν.
paragraphs.translit: alla synekleisen hē graphē ta panta hypo hamartian hina hē epangelia ek pisteōs Iēsou Christou dothē tois pisteuousin.

paragraphs.text: But before faith came, we were kept in ward under the law, shut up unto the faith which should afterwards be revealed.
paragraphs.original: Πρὸ τοῦ δὲ ἐλθεῖν τὴν πίστιν ὑπὸ νόμον ἐφρουρούμεθα συγκλειόμενοι εἰς τὴν μέλλουσαν πίστιν ἀποκαλυφθῆναι.
paragraphs.translit: Pro tou de elthein tēn pistin hypo nomon ephrouroumetha synkleiomenoi eis tēn mellousan pistin apokalyphthēnai.

paragraphs.text: So that the law is become our tutor [to bring us] unto Christ, that we might be justified by faith.
paragraphs.original: ὥστε ὁ νόμος παιδαγωγὸς ἡμῶν γέγονεν εἰς Χριστόν, ἵνα ἐκ πίστεως δικαιωθῶμεν·
paragraphs.translit: hōste ho nomos paidagōgos hēmōn gegonen eis Christon, hina ek pisteōs dikaiōthōmen·

paragraphs.text: But now faith that is come, we are no longer under a tutor.
paragraphs.original: ἐλθούσης δὲ τῆς πίστεως οὐκέτι ὑπὸ παιδαγωγόν ἐσμεν.
paragraphs.translit: elthousēs de tēs pisteōs ouketi hypo paidagōgon esmen.

paragraphs.text: For ye are all sons of God, through faith, in Christ Jesus.
paragraphs.original: πάντες γὰρ υἱοὶ θεοῦ ἐστε διὰ τῆς πίστεως ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: pantes gar hyioi theou este dia tēs pisteōs en Christō Iēsou.

paragraphs.text: For as many of you as were baptized into Christ did put on Christ.
paragraphs.original: ὅσοι γὰρ εἰς Χριστὸν ἐβαπτίσθητε, Χριστὸν ἐνεδύσασθε·
paragraphs.translit: hosoi gar eis Christon ebaptisthēte, Christon enedysasthe·

paragraphs.text: There can be neither Jew nor Greek, there can be neither bond nor free, there can be no male and female; for ye all are one [man] in Christ Jesus.
paragraphs.original: οὐκ ἔνι Ἰουδαῖος οὐδὲ Ἕλλην, οὐκ ἔνι δοῦλος οὐδὲ ἐλεύθερος, οὐκ ἔνι ἄρσεν καὶ θῆλυ· πάντες γὰρ ὑμεῖς εἷς ἐστε ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: ouk eni Ioudaios oude Hellēn, ouk eni doulos oude eleutheros, ouk eni arsen kai thēly· pantes gar hymeis heis este en Christō Iēsou.

paragraphs.text: And if ye are Christ`s, then are ye Abraham`s seed, heirs according to promise.
paragraphs.original: εἰ δὲ ὑμεῖς Χριστοῦ, ἄρα τοῦ Ἀβραὰμ σπέρμα ἐστέ, κατʼ ἐπαγγελίαν κληρονόμοι.
paragraphs.translit: ei de hymeis Christou, ara tou Abraam sperma este, katʼ epangelian klēronomoi.
